name: td-mcp-rs
description: Connects Claude Code to a running TouchDesigner via td-mcp-rs: registers the local MCP server (fleet/inspect/mutate_nodes/execute_python/capture/...) and bundles the TouchDesigner operate skill so Claude reaches for the right tool without being told.

daemon_path.title: tdmcp-daemon binary
daemon_path.description: Path to the tdmcp-daemon executable. Run `tdmcp-daemon install` first (see the repo README), then point this at the installed binary — e.g. ~/Library/Application Support/tdmcp-rs/bin/tdmcp-daemon or /Applications/tdmcp.app/Contents/MacOS/tdmcp-daemon on macOS, %LOCALAPPDATA%\tdmcp-rs\bin\tdmcp-daemon.exe or %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\tdmcp-rs\tdmcp-daemon.exe on Windows. Leave the default if tdmcp-daemon is already on your PATH.
